title: What Does Multi-Harness RL Learn? Credit Assignment and Portability in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.04518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly runs through full execution harnesses, and a multi-harness recipe mixes two choices: exposing the policy to several harnesses, and comparing their rewards inside one relative-advantage group. We isolate the second choice in repository-level coding. From one Qwen3-8B supervised warm start we replay the same frozen task-harness records from Aider, OpenHands, Qwen Code, and SWE-agent, with the same number of updates, under two rules for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), Within (one group per task-harness pair) and Cross (harnesses pooled within a task), and score every checkpoint with a sealed SWE-bench Verified oracle on four source harnesses and a minimal harness held out of training. The evaluation harness is the dominant variable: across 24,000 sealed evaluations it moves the mean solve rate from 2.14\% to 9.27\%, a factor of 4.3, where the training recipe moves it by 1.16. translated_title: 多执行框架强化学习学到了什么？编码智能体中的功劳分配与可移植性
translated_abstract: 智能体强化学习（RL）越来越多地通过完整的执行框架运行，而多框架配方混合了两个选择：将策略暴露给多个框架，以及在一个相对优势组内比较它们的奖励。我们在仓库级编码任务中分离出第二个选择。从同一个 Qwen3-8B 监督热启动出发，我们以相同的更新次数重放来自 Aider、OpenHands、Qwen Code 和 SWE-agent 的相同冻结任务-框架记录，在组相对策略优化（GRPO）的两种规则下进行训练——Within（每个任务-框架对一组）和 Cross（同一任务内各框架合并为一组）——并用密封的 SWE-bench Verified 预言机对每个检查点在四个源框架和一个未参与训练的最小框架上进行评分。评估框架是主导变量：在 24,000 次密封评估中，它使平均解决率从 2.14% 变动到 9.27%，相差 4.3 倍，而训练配方仅使其变动 1.16。
tldr: 该研究发现，在多框架强化学习训练编码智能体时，评估框架是决定性能的主导变量（使平均解决率相差4.3倍），远超训练配方本身的影响。
en_tdlr: In multi-harness RL for coding agents, the evaluation harness is the dominant variable, moving mean solve rate by a factor of 4.3 compared to only 1.16 for the training recipe.
